verdict.rationale: HubSpot's AI features docs describe natural-language reporting ('describe the report you need in plain language, and HubSpot will build it') and AI agents that surface signals and suggest next steps (prospecting agent, smart deal progression, follow-up drafts), which are AI-generated insights/suggestions from CRM data. However, these are marketing-page claims without independent hands-on validation or detail on where/how insights surface in-product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight quality, concrete UI examples of AI-generated insights inside records/dashboards, and confirmation these are broadly available (not just premium/beta tiers).
